title: Page 9
slug: 良膳小娘子下-子纹-面对偏心偏到天边去的家人赵小丫这世学聪明了-被当奴婢使唤嫁给傻子换银子的烂事绝不会再发生-娘亲与姊姊
lines: 赵小丫端坐在椅上，正好看到对面痛得缩着身子捂着肚子，却还是狠狠瞪着周屹天的卫昭同。
看他一身狼狈，赵小丫的心一阵波动，想起上辈子自己被推落水中——那时卫昭同应该是知道自己的身世才会对她痛下杀手，想要来个死无对证。
这便解释得通，她在京城安安分分多年，并无树敌，就是个不起眼的人物，却偏偏在遇上赵雪和刘彩凤之后死于非命。
她悄悄将自己的手塞进了周屹天的掌心之中，因见到卫昭同而起的纷乱心思缓缓的平复下来。
卫元召虽然对周屹天隐瞒众人急着娶赵小丫进门一事有气，但见他一来就震慑得刘彩凤和赵雪连哭都不敢哭出声，卫昭同也缩着脖子做人，耳根子清静多了，顿时说话口气也好了些，“还有谁会来？”
周屹天握着赵小丫的手轻捏着，连眼神都不给一个。
卫元召翻了个白眼。
宋氏擦了擦自己的泪，目光有着茫然，一时不知该去问卫昭同伤势，还是去拉赵小丫好好说上几句话。
看出她的坐立难安，卫阁老叹了口气，想安慰，终究还是选择沉默，如今他的心也是乱赵小丫猜到等的人是赵老爹，但最后才知，她的思虑还是不及周屹天。
第二十章 身世大白(2)
众人等来的不只赵老爹一人，而是三人。
刘彩凤看到被抬进屋的赵老爹，整个人都抖了起来。
赵雪则是在看到跟在赵老爹身后，没有规矩四处抬头张望的李虎母子时，脸色一白。
李大婶看到她，双眼恨恨的瞪住她，巴不得在她身上瞪出两个窟窿，要不是有顾良拦就上去给她两巴掌了。
“说吧。”周屹天没理会神色迥异的几人，径自说道。
被放下的赵老爹挣扎着跪了下来，老泪纵横，“是我的罪过，是我失心疯，我该死。”
宋氏只在刘彩凤成亲时见过赵老爹一次，如今多年过去，她早已不复记忆，正要开口却被冷着脸的卫阁老制止，她只能默不吭声。
“我叫赵明，当年我们确实换了两个娃子。”
“死老头，你胡说什么！”刘彩凤扑过来捶打赵老爹，“我跟你拚了，今天咱俩都别活了！”
赵老爹被打得毫无招架之力，跌倒在地。
顾良上前轻轻一拽，就把刘彩凤给挥到一旁。
刘彩凤吼道：“他胡说八道，他疯了！”
卫昭同惨白着一张脸，看着眼前一切，觉得自己的世界逼近崩溃。
赵老爹泪流满面，艰难的爬起来，给卫阁老和宋氏磕头，“那天孩子几乎同时出世，但……”他看着一脸震惊的宋氏，说道：“夫人昏了过去，我们一时鬼迷心窍才把孩子给换了。”
卫阁老神色复杂，“那可是你赵家的男丁，你如何舍得？”
赵老爹泣不成声，“我没出息，生了孩子也是跟着我过苦日子，但是跟着大人不一样。大人学问好，还要进京当大官，孩子养在大人家里肯定比在村子里长大强。”
卫阁老气得一张脸涨红，想他聪明一世，竟然连自己的孩儿被偷天换日都不知。
他的目光落在赵小丫身上，却看见她眼睛看的不是他这个亲爹，而长跪地痛哭的养父。
他的心一阵抽痛。
赵小丫怜悯的看着赵老爹，如今终于明白为何他看向自己的眼神总是复杂，老实了一辈子的人，换了别人家的孩子，这事儿是他这辈子压在心中永远搬不开的大石。
“不是！你们胡说八道，你们才不是我爹娘！”卫昭同疯了似的跳起来，向赵老爹挥拳。
“来人啊，把……”卫元召顿了一下，“二爷拉开。”
外头的护院进来，架开了卫昭同。
赵老爹悲哀的看着拚命挣扎的他，“当初你姥姥说，你手腕上有个红色胎记，将来必是个有福之人。”
宋氏再也坐不住，猛然站起身。
她记得她痛得快要晕过去时，确实听到胎记、有福之人这几个字，而那时她的孩子还没出世，醒了之后看到卫昭同身上的胎记，她没多想，只以为赵家闺女身上也有胎记罢了。
卫昭同看里宋氏的举动，一时忘了挣扎，在他印象之中，宋氏总是温顺优雅，从未失态。
“夫人。”卫阁老也跟着站起身，扶住了宋氏摇摇晃晃的身子。
“小……”宋氏忍着情绪开口，却叫不出口，若这真是她的闺女，她的闺女竟然连个正经名字都没有，这叫她情何以堪？
“你身上可有胎记？”
赵小丫看着宋氏，实在不忍见她一脸自责内疚，眼眶忍不住红了。
“无。”周屹天冷冷的声音丢了过来。他是她的夫君，她身上每一寸他都看过，并无胎记。
宋氏双手握拳，冲到刘彩凤的面前扬起手狠狠的甩了她一巴掌。
刘彩凤吃痛，一脸惊讶。
宋氏这辈子从未发过脾气，如今却是巴不得杀了眼前人，反手又是一掌。
“你疯了！”刘彩凤吼道。
“我是疯了！”宋氏回吼，“你丧尽天良，换了我女儿！我昏过去前，你先我产子，我听到你娘说了胎记，说孩子是个有福之人。”
刘彩凤浑身一僵。
卫阁老上前一把将宋氏给护住，并道：“来人啊！把这对毒夫毒妇给绑了，送到大理寺法办。”
刘彩凤挣扎着要逃，但几个奴仆进来将她压制住，赵老爹则是一脸认命的任由他们处置。
虽说两人是罪有应得，但看到赵老爹不良于行却被拖着出去，赵小丫的心还是闷痛了下。
赵雪缩在柱子旁，心中不甘又恐惧的看着爹娘被拖了出去。
她怎么也想不到，她向来看不起的赵小丫竟然是卫阁老的亲女，被她爹娘心狠的换了。
“不可能——爹、娘！”卫昭同吼道：“我才是你们的儿子，我才是！”
卫阁老闭了下眼，养了十数年的孩子，说没感情是假的，但一想到自己护养着卫昭同成长，卫昭同的亲生父母却虐待他的孩子，连个正经名字都不给，他现在连看卫昭同一眼都觉得心痛。
“把二爷带回屋去。”卫阁老发话，他会处理卫昭同，但不是现在。
卫昭同不甘不愿，大吼大叫的被拖离厅堂。
宋氏走到赵小丫的面前，哭着一把将人给抱进怀里。
周屹天原本握着赵小丫的手一空，眉头几不可察的轻皱了下。
赵小丫静静的被宋氏抱着，闻着宋氏身上飘来的馨香，耳里听她哭得心碎，这是娘亲——
原来这便是娘亲的味道。
到底是血脉至亲，她的眼眶也不由自主的泛红，掉下了眼泪。
卫阁老满怀愧疚，热切的凝视自己的妻女，上前将手放在两人的身上，最后也没忍住，激动的将两人都搂在怀中。
周屹天的神情又冷了几分，看到卫元召也红着眼上前，再也不忍了，站起身一手挡住卫元召，一手将赵小丫拉回自己身边，“还有外人在。”
众人这才记起跟着赵老爹前来的两人。
李大婶被方才厅堂里上演的大戏弄得傻了眼，现下回过神，忙拉着李虎进屋。
“大人。”李大婶头一回进京，看着卫阁老也害怕，拉着李虎跪下来，“这是我儿子李虎，我是带他来找儿媳妇的。”
卫阁老的眼底闪过一丝困惑。
李大婶记得带她来的大汉交代过，手忙脚乱的翻出衣襟内已经捏得皱巴巴的一张红纸，“这是我儿子跟赵雪的婚书。”
赵雪瞪大了眼，“你说谎，我们根本就没成亲，哪来的婚书？”
content_en:
Zhao Xiaoya was sitting on the chair, and happened to see Wei Zhaotong across from him, who was shrinking in pain and holding his stomach, but still stared at Zhou Yitian fiercely.
Seeing him in such a mess, Zhao Xiaoya's heart fluctuated, remembering that she was pushed into the water in her previous life - at that time, Wei Zhaotong should have known about her life experience before killing her, and wanted to die without proof.
This makes sense. She had lived peacefully in the capital for many years without making any enemies. She was just an inconspicuous person, but she died unexpectedly after meeting Zhao Xue and Liu Caifeng.
She quietly put her hand into Zhou Yitian's palm, and the chaotic thoughts caused by seeing Wei Zhaotong slowly calmed down.
Although Wei Yuanzhao was angry with Zhou Yitian for concealing the fact that everyone was in a hurry to marry Zhao Xiaoya, he was so shocked when he came that Liu Caifeng and Zhao Xue did not even dare to cry. Wei Zhaotong also shrank his neck, his ears were much quieter, and his tone of voice suddenly became better, "Who else will come?"
Zhou Yitian took Zhao Xiaoya's hand and squeezed it gently without even looking at her.
Wei Yuanzhao rolled his eyes.
Mrs. Song wiped her tears with a blank look in her eyes. She didn't know whether to ask Wei Zhaotong about his injury or to ask Zhao Xiaoya for a few words.
Seeing that she was restless, Mr. Wei Ge sighed and wanted to comfort him, but in the end he chose to remain silent. Now his heart was also in confusion. Zhao Xiaoya guessed that the person waiting was Father Zhao, but in the end he realized that she was still not as thoughtful as Zhou Yitian.
Chapter 20: Life experience revealed (2)
Everyone was waiting for not only Father Zhao, but three people.
Liu Caifeng trembled when she saw Father Zhao being carried into the house.
Zhao Xue's face turned pale when she saw Li Hu and her son, who were following behind Mr. Zhao and looking up in all directions.
When Aunt Li saw her, she glared at her with hatred, wishing that two holes would be made in her body. If Gu Liang hadn't stopped her, she would have gone up and slapped her twice.
"Say it." Zhou Yitian ignored the people with different expressions and said directly.
After being put down, Mr. Zhao struggled to kneel down and burst into tears. "It's my fault. It's my fault. I'm crazy. I deserve to die."
Mrs. Song only met Mr. Zhao once when Liu Caifeng got married. Now many years have passed and she has long lost her memory. She was about to speak but was stopped by the cold-faced Mr. Wei Ge, so she could only remain silent.
"My name is Zhao Ming. We did have two children that year."
"Old man, what nonsense are you talking about!" Liu Caifeng rushed over and beat Zhao Lao, "I will fight with you, neither of us will survive today!"
Father Zhao was beaten to the point where he was helpless and fell to the ground.
Gu Liang stepped forward and waved Liu Caifeng aside with a gentle tug.
Liu Caifeng shouted: "He is talking nonsense, he is crazy!"
Wei Zhaotong's face was pale. Looking at everything in front of him, he felt that his world was about to collapse.
With tears streaming down his face, Father Zhao got up with difficulty and kowtowed to Mr. Wei Ge and Madam Song. "The children were born almost at the same time that day, but..." He looked at Madam Song who looked shocked and said, "Madam passed out. We were so obsessed that we changed the child."
Elder Wei Ge looked complicated, "That's the son of your Zhao family, how can you let it go?"
Father Zhao burst into tears, "I have no future, and even if I have a child, I will live a hard life with you, but it is different with an adult. The adult is well-educated and wants to go to Beijing to become a high official. It is definitely better for the child to be raised in an adult's home than to grow up in a village."
Mr. Wei Ge was so angry that his face turned red. He thought he was so smart that he didn't even know that his child had been stolen.
His eyes fell on Zhao Xiaoya, but he saw that her eyes were not looking at him, his biological father, but at his adoptive father, who was kneeling down and crying bitterly.
His heart throbbed.
Zhao Xiaoya looked at Father Zhao with pity, and now she finally understood why he always looked at her with complicated eyes. The fact that a person who had been honest all his life was replaced by someone else's child was a big stone that he could never remove from his heart.
"No! You are talking nonsense, you are not my parents!" Wei Zhaotong jumped up like crazy and punched Zhao Lao.
"Come here, please..." Wei Yuanzhao paused, "Second Master, pull away."
The nurse from outside came in and pushed Wei Zhaotong away.
Father Zhao looked at him sadly as he struggled desperately, "Your grandma said that if you have a red birthmark on your wrist, you will be a blessed person in the future."
Mrs. Song couldn't sit still anymore and stood up suddenly.
She remembered that when she was about to faint from the pain, she did hear the words birthmark and blessed person. Her child had not yet been born at that time. When she woke up and saw the birthmark on Wei Zhaotong, she didn't think much about it and just thought that the daughter of the Zhao family also had a birthmark.
When Wei Zhaotong saw Song's actions, he forgot to struggle for a moment. In his impression, Song was always meek and elegant and never lost his composure.
"Madam." Mr. Wei Ge also stood up and supported Mrs. Song's swaying body.
"Little..." Mrs. Song held back her emotions and spoke, but she couldn't say it. If this was really her daughter, her daughter didn't even have a proper name. How could she be embarrassed?
"Do you have a birthmark on your body?"
Zhao Xiaoya looked at Mrs. Song and couldn't bear to see her face full of self-blame and guilt, and her eyes couldn't help but turn red.
"Nothing." Zhou Yitian's cold voice came over. He is her husband, he has seen every inch of her body, and there is no birthmark.
Mrs. Song clenched her hands into fists, rushed in front of Liu Caifeng, raised her hand and slapped her hard.
Liu Caifeng was in pain and looked surprised.
Song had never lost his temper in his life, but now he was eager to kill the person in front of him, and gave him another slap with his backhand.
"You're crazy!" Liu Caifeng shouted.
"I'm crazy!" Ms. Song shouted back, "You are so unconscionable that you replaced my daughter! Before I passed out, you gave birth to the baby before me. I heard your mother mention the birthmark and that the baby was a blessed person."
Liu Caifeng froze.
Mr. Wei Ge stepped forward to protect Mrs. Song and said, "Here comes someone! Tie up this poisonous husband and woman and send them to Dali Temple for justice."
Liu Caifeng struggled to escape, but several slaves came in and suppressed her, while Mr. Zhao resigned to their fate with a look of resignation.
Although the two of them deserved their punishment, Zhao Xiaoya's heart still ached when she saw that Mr. Zhao was dragged out because of his bad behavior.
Zhao Xue huddled next to the pillar, watching her parents being dragged out with reluctance and fear.
She never imagined that Zhao Xiaoya, whom she had always looked down upon, was actually the biological daughter of Mr. Wei Ge, who was cruelly replaced by her parents.
"Impossible—Father, mother!" Wei Zhaotong shouted: "I am your son, I am the one!"
Mr. Wei Ge closed his eyes. He had raised a child for more than ten years. It was a lie to say that he had no feelings. But when he thought that he had raised Wei Zhaotong, Wei Zhaotong's biological parents abused his child and did not even give him a proper name. He felt heartbroken even looking at Wei Zhaotong now.
"Take the second master back to the house." Elder Wei Ge said. He would deal with Wei Zhaotong, but not now.
Wei Zhaotong was unwilling to do so and was dragged out of the hall while yelling.
Mrs. Song walked up to Zhao Xiaoya and hugged her into her arms while crying.
Zhou Yitian's hand that was originally holding Zhao Xiaoya's was empty, and his brows furrowed slightly, almost unnoticeably.
Zhao Xiaoya was quietly held by Mrs. Song, smelling the sweet fragrance coming from Mrs. Song's body, and hearing her cry heartbreakingly. This is her mother——
It turns out that this is what my mother smells like.
After all, they were blood relatives, so her eyes turned red involuntarily and she shed tears.
Elder Wei Ge was full of guilt and stared at his wife and daughter eagerly. He stepped forward and put his hands on both of them. In the end, he couldn't hold back and hugged both of them excitedly.
Zhou Yitian's expression became a little colder. When he saw Wei Yuanzhao coming forward with red eyes, he couldn't bear it anymore. He stood up and blocked Wei Yuanzhao with one hand, and pulled Zhao Xiaoya back to him with the other hand, "There are still outsiders here."
Only then did everyone remember the two people who had followed Mr. Zhao.
Aunt Li was dumbfounded by the drama that had just been played in the hall. Now she came to her senses and hurriedly pulled Li Hu into the house.
"Sir." Aunt Li came to Beijing for the first time. She was scared when she saw Mr. Wei Ge, and pulled Li Hu to kneel down. "This is my son Li Hu. I brought him to find my daughter-in-law."
A trace of confusion flashed in Mr. Wei Ge's eyes.
Aunt Li remembered what the big man who brought her here had told her, and she hurriedly pulled out a crumpled piece of red paper from her lapel, "This is the marriage certificate between my son and Zhao Xue."
Zhao Xue's eyes widened, "You lied, we are not married at all, where did the marriage certificate come from?"
